design.name: 夔
design.role: 4-1 领主 · 经幡山头（雷暴时现身）
design.brief: Kui (夔), the one-legged thunder beast of the Shan Hai Jing ('like an ox, grey-blue, hornless, with ONE LEG; whenever it enters or leaves the water there is wind and rain; its light is like the sun and moon, its voice like thunder'), whose hide the Yellow Emperor made into a war drum. It returns as a storm revenant about 6 m tall. HEAD: a colossal hornless OX head, clearly bovine: a broad flat cattle muzzle with a wide dark nose pad and big nostrils, heavy brow, small cattle ears sticking out sideways, a thick dewlap, NO horns (only two worn stumps), blazing white-violet eyes; NOT a bear (no round bear ears, no pointed bear snout). BODY: a massive hunched front body of grey-blue hide in big carved plates; a huge open ribcage on its chest framing a tattered round DRUM SKIN stretched over the ribs and painted with red thunder spirals (the drum it lost), a glowing magenta-violet core behind a tear in the drum (weak spot); solid sculpted grey-blue and white storm-cloud shapes on its shoulders and back. LIMBS: it stands on EXACTLY ONE thick central leg ending in one huge hoof (no second leg, no hind legs), and has two VERY LONG, thick, gorilla-like ARMS, longer than its leg, ending in big hoof-fists bound with copper bands: standing upright the arms hang so the fists reach below the knee, nearly to the ground, and when it leans forward it walks on the knuckles of both fists like a gorilla on crutches, swinging its one leg through between them. Main pose: this tripod stance, leaning forward with both knuckle-fists planted on the ground in front of it and the single leg behind, roaring. Front, side and back views: standing upright on its one leg with the long arms hanging. Majestic and terrifying.
design.style_note: Stylization: cartoon game proportions in the same family as the earlier rosters (jerboa soldier, fire rat, sancai tomb beast, huodou sighthound): chunky simplified masses, oversized heads and paws, toy-like readable forms with clean bevelled edges. Lightning is painted as OPAQUE glowing magenta-violet zig-zag veins and solid sculpted spark shapes on the body (never transparent bolts, particles, smoke or glow halos); fur, hair and feathers as a few large carved clumps.
design.note: 2026-10-18 v002：长臂（蹦跳 + 双拳拄地步态要够得着地）、无角牛头（v001 头偏熊）
design.turnaround_lead: Symmetric bind pose for rigging (it has ONE leg):
design.turnaround_pose: standing upright on its single central leg with the hoof flat on the ground, the hunched body balanced over it; both very long arms hanging straight down beside the body with a gap of air, the hoof-fists closed and reaching below the knee; the hornless ox head facing straight ahead with the mouth closed; the drum skin on the chest, the red thunder spirals and the glowing core painted opaque (no halo); the storm-cloud shapes on the shoulders and back as solid sculpted forms; MODELLING BASE STATE WITH EFFECTS SEPARATED: nothing glows and nothing emits light anywhere: no bloom, no halo, no light spill on the surrounding fur, no sparks, no electric arcs, and no crystal-like or spark-shaped spikes sticking out of the body (all of those are added later as game effects); every lightning vein is only a thin FLAT painted magenta line on the surface, like a tattoo, with crisp edges and the same matte lighting as the rest of the body; the eyes are flat painted colour; the core behind the torn drum skin is a flat painted magenta-violet patch
design.turnaround_digits: EXACTLY ONE leg and one hoof in every view (never two legs); each hoof-fist with its copper bands clearly visible; the whole body, the cloud shapes and the fists fully inside the frame.
